notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Myr without summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Urtet triggers, untapping each Myr you control.
Activate five Myr by tapping them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
